## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and the affected provider or screen.

## Verification

State the command or manual scenario used to verify this change.

## Checklist

- [ ] This pull request is focused and excludes unrelated changes.
- [ ] I followed [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and, for provider work, the [provider development guide](../docs/provider-development.md).
- [ ] I did not include API keys, OAuth tokens, cookies, credential files, browser exports, or screenshots/logs containing them.
- [ ] I redacted sensitive account data from screenshots and diagnostics.
- [ ] I documented visible UI changes with a non-sensitive screenshot, if applicable.
